summary: Li Bang International Corp Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a private investment in public equity (PIPE) transaction. On August 13, 2026, the company entered into a securities purchase agreement to issue 88,235 Class B ordinary shares at $3.40 per share to entities controlled by its CEO and a director, with gross proceeds of $300,000. The transaction closed on August 17, 2026, and proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes. Disinterested board members approved the deal. Class B shares are unlisted restricted securities. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
